title: Hot and straight trumpet players, and the second Kid Punch band
summary: Miller names the hot street musicians and straight readers, and tells of an imitator called second Kid Punch.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I'm about to run out, Punch.
I'm about to run out. So? Yeah. Unless you want to name some of the other outstanding musicians.
Unless you want to tell me some more of the other hot musicians.
You know, and who the hot ones were and who the straight ones were.
Well, the hot ones were, up and down the street. Chris Kelly, Kid Renee, Sam Morgan. And I said, well I was long there with them. And, uh, the little Carl Sidney Dutton, he was one of that bunch too.
He was a righty trumpet player.

Yeah, see, that was he was. There's fellas out there, boy. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh, there's none of this four years. Tell me he dropped data at Ramp-Ardon, Cornell. Ramp-Ardon, Tulane. He was going in the name of second Kid Punch, see. Uh-huh. I didn't know nothing about him. But I could hear people talking about second Kid Punch. Well, I was at Milling Bird one day playing on a Sunday. Uh-huh. He was going in the name of second Kid Punch, see. I didn't know nothing about him, but I could hear people talking about second Kid Punch. Well I was at Milling Bird one day playing on a Sunday, and everybody said Kid Punch and then Fell Dave. And boy I was cheating myself and pinching myself, I didn't know what was going on there. And so I found out it was an infernal band called the second Kid Punch Band.
Well who was the uh... I don't know what his name was, nothing. Who was the other you know kind of straight trumpet man and straight reading guys, couldn't get off much?
Well I started to say Kemba, but he got off too. Well, see, they had to be in them bands like with P. Ron. Willie Edwards was one.
He was a straight reader, but he played out there with P. Ron. And Kemba was a straight reader, but he could... He could...
